hints.title: Initial Overlap Merging
hints.text: Sort intervals by start coordinate and merge all naturally overlapping intervals to produce disjoint groups.

hints.title: Bridging Right Reach
hints.text: Placing the new interval of length k starting at merged[i][1] extends continuous coverage to merged[i][1] + k.

hints.title: Binary Search Farthest Bridge
hints.text: Use binary search on start coordinates to find the farthest group j reachable within reach. Maximizing j - i minimizes remaining groups.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting takes O(n log n). Binary searches on m merged intervals take O(m log m).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all possible float/integer placement positions directly is continuous and intractable.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for merged intervals.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Merges overlapping intervals first, then maximizes bridged groups via binary search.
